fact: The Office Burundais des Recettes presented on 17 February 2026 the new web version of the Guichet Unique Electronique for import permits, which centralises procedures of the medicines regulator ABREMA, the agriculture ministry (sanitary and phytosanitary certificates) and the OBR, and is now the exclusive route for pharmaceutical importers.

The Office Burundais des Recettes says the web-based ABREMA module of the electronic single window for medicine imports was presented on 17 February 2026, with the OBR, commercial banks and customs agents as partners, and use of the platform mandatory for medicine importers from 18 February 2026.

TradeMark Africa reports that the customs systems of Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi are interconnected through the East African Community Single Customs Territory Centralised Platform, unveiled in revamped form on 27 January 2025.
